experiment: Clean attribution of trajectory auxiliary supervision to crossing-intention prediction
common_hyperparameters_source: Read epochs, batch size, hidden dim, learning rate, prior weight, ambiguous weight, gate mode, and data roots from frozen historical lambda100 checkpoint args; assert expected published values before execution.

selection.tie_break: lower raw validation Brier when raw AUC difference is at most 1e-4

initialization.strategy: Create exactly one initial state per seed; load the same file in both arms.
required: max absolute parameter difference equals zero

data_order.record: full main-sampler sequence SHA256 and first 32 indices for each epoch; pairwise equality required

test_policy: Do not open, inspect, hash, or evaluate test.npz before all six formal runs and protocol freeze.
primary_endpoint: raw official-test intention ROC-AUC; paired delta J100-clean minus J0-clean
trajectory_metrics_role: diagnostic only; never used for scheduler or checkpoint selection

historical_reference.use: secondary contextual comparison only; not the clean primary comparator

support_rules.strong: mean clean delta AUC > 0.03, at least 2/3 seed deltas > 0, at least 2/3 per-seed scene-bootstrap 95% AUC CI lower bounds > 0, and no clear seed-SD explosion
support_rules.moderate: mean clean delta AUC > 0.02, at least 2/3 seed directions positive, but most bootstrap intervals cross zero
support_rules.weak: mean clean delta AUC > 0 but direction is unstable or effect is small
support_rules.no_support: mean clean delta AUC approximately zero (absolute value <= 0.01) or no stable difference
support_rules.seed_sd_interpretation: Operationalize no abnormal explosion before clean test access as clean J100 AUC sample SD <= 2.0 times the historical J100 AUC sample SD (historically 0.0135; cutoff 0.0270). Report both values and the ratio.
